Chapter 375: Chapter 2 Chikun Star Lord: Disciple, why is your Inner World so large? (Please Subscribe)_3

The Red Spirit Fluid contained within could certainly be described as a massive amount.

“It’s finally been delivered…”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

“Time to begin expanding the Inner World.”

Lin Yuan let out a sigh of relief, “The commotion caused by the expansion of the Inner World this time… I’m afraid it won’t be easy to conceal…”

It suddenly occurred to Lin Yuan.

...

When breaking through to the Seventh Rank, the Inner World Lin Yuan had created was only ten miles in radius.

With Lin Yuan’s grasp of power and deductions through his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, it was enough to conceal his actions from ordinary Eighth Layer Evolvers, who wouldn’t notice a thing.

But next.

The Inner World of Lin Yuan was about to expand to more than ten thousand miles in radius. Such a great disturbance would be hard to suppress; if left unchecked, it would alarm the entire Chikun Main Star.

With that in mind.

Lin Yuan immediately contacted the Chikun Star Lord.

“Teacher, I need your help to cover up my next cultivation practice.”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness connected to the Virtual World and arrived at the teacher’s crimson-colored palace, where he was in seclusion.

To the Chikun Star Lord, Lin Yuan didn’t need to hide anything, after all, this was his own teacher, and the Star Lord must surely be aware of the substantial amount of Red Spirit Fluid he had requested before.

“Cover it up?”

The Chikun Star Lord looked at his disciple, a smile appearing on his face, “Not bad, my good disciple knows to talk to his teacher about things.”

Even if Lin Yuan hadn’t said anything, the Chikun Star Lord would have paid extra attention during this period.

If Lin Yuan were truly opening up an Inner World as the Chikun Star Lord suspected, he would definitely help to conceal the disturbance.

But Lin Yuan taking the initiative to speak up still put the Chikun Star Lord in a good mood.

“Is it related to the Inner World?”

Although the Chikun Star Lord already had his suspicions, he still asked one more question.

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan hesitated for a moment, then nodded and said.

Inwardly he was quite emotional; it was no wonder his teacher was an invincible being of the Eighth Layer – all his little secrets were probably seen through already.

“Very well.”

The Chikun Star Lord was overjoyed upon receiving confirmation from Lin Yuan.

Generally, only when an Evolver was at the Seventh-Rank Peak and about to make the push for the Eighth Rank, with a sufficient foundation built up, would they attempt to open up an Inner World.

Now that Lin Yuan, still at the Seventh Rank, was attempting to open up an Inner World, even by the standards of the ‘Annan’ Star Alliance, it would be considered an exceptional feat.

What the Chikun Star Lord didn’t know was that Lin Yuan had actually begun carving out his Inner World while at the Sixth Rank.

“Go ahead.”

“No matter the commotion.”

“Your teacher will cover for you.”

The Chikun Star Lord waved his hand grandly and said.

“Thank you, teacher.”

Lin Yuan expressed his gratitude somewhat emotionally.

…

After Lin Yuan left.

The Chikun Star Lord grew curious.

“I wonder how many miles my obedient disciple’s Inner World will reach?”

“One mile in radius? Three miles, or five miles?”

The Chikun Star Lord pondered silently.

Even a Seventh-Rank Peak Evolver typically had an Inner World with a radius of only ten miles, and it was not until stepping into the Eighth Rank that their Inner World would suddenly surge to a hundred miles.

As for Lin Yuan, who wasn’t even at the Seventh-Rank Peak, the Inner World he carved out would typically not exceed five miles in radius.

“We’ll see.”

The Chikun Star Lord looked in the direction of the Thirteen Peaks.

Being on the Chikun Main Star, he was able to intervene instantly anywhere.

…

“With my teacher guaranteeing safety,”

“I can begin.”

Lin Yuan’s consciousness entered his Inner World, starting to release the suppression.

Boom boom boom.

At the world’s edge, space began to shatter, a great deal of spatial force converged, continuously deriving and enlarging the Inner World.

Outside.

Bottle after bottle of the Red Spirit Fluid merged into Lin Yuan’s body, serving as an energy supplement for the expansion of the Inner World.

Boom boom boom.

As the Inner World expanded wildly.

Threads of World Force still leaked out beyond Lin Yuan’s control.

Faintly above Lin Yuan, a colossal World Shadow began to form.

The World Shadow was vast and boundless, and in the blink of an eye, it surpassed ten thousand miles.

Then.

Twenty thousand miles.

Thirty thousand miles.

Fifty thousand miles.

…

Inside the crimson palace.

The Chikun Star Lord was constantly monitoring the activity at the Thirteen Peaks.

When faint traces of spatial force and World Force fluctuations reached the top of the Thirteen Peaks, a smile couldn’t help but appear on the Chikun Star Lord’s face.

Lin Yuan’s opening of an Inner World before reaching the Seventh-Rank Peak indicated an extremely powerful talent and aptitude, and as his teacher, how could the Chikun Star Lord not be delighted?

“Three miles or five miles…”

Closely observing the fluctuations formed by the escaping spatial force and World Force, the Chikun Star Lord reasoned from his experience that the size of the World Shadow formed by these forces escaping was equivalent to the actual size of the Inner World.

The next instant.

“Hmm?”

The Chikun Star Lord’s eyes widened.

“This is not good.”

The Chikun Star Lord disappeared in a flash.

In an instant, he arrived before the Thirteen Peaks, then raised his right hand. The heavens and earth transformed, and this area was directly severed from the Chikun Main Star.

Boom boom boom.

The enormous World Shadow rapidly swelled.

The Chikun Star Lord looked up at the World Shadow that had reached eighty thousand, ninety thousand miles, momentarily at a loss for words.

“My good disciple, isn’t your Inner World a little too big?”

The Chikun Star Lord looked down at the Thirteen Peaks below, then raised his eyes toward the vast World Shadow, now nearing a hundred thousand miles, and began to doubt himself.

Was his obedient disciple really at the Seventh Rank or the Eighth?
